title: Production ASR promotion protocol v0 (one multilingual artifact)
basis: ARCH-2026-001 + Codex review #5 recommendation 5 + the sealed-holdout discipline proven in B5-KW-V2-GATE-PROTOCOL-2026-001
principles: aggregate WER alone can NEVER promote an artifact
all thresholds are PREDECLARED before any sealed observation
every sealed set is consumed exactly once per candidate
checkpoint selection and promotion evidence use disjoint sets

each candidate's packet PREDECLARES, per protected language, the non-inferiority margin, the statistical test and the alpha BEFORE its sealed run — the protocol names the gates, the packet names the numbers

gates_v0_active_now.target_languages: meaningful predeclared relative WER improvement on sealed speaker-disjoint holdouts
gates_v0_active_now.protected_languages: predeclared statistical NON-INFERIORITY on every protected language (replay anchors english/french; regression sentinels swahili/lingala; plus every language the artifact already served)
gates_v0_active_now.degenerate_output: hallucination-rate, deletion-rate and silence-behaviour screens on the sealed sets (measurable today from existing transcripts)
gates_v0_active_now.operational: streaming latency envelope, VRAM ceiling on the serving instance class, cancellation behaviour, wrong-language-hint robustness (soft hints must degrade gracefully, never hard-fail)

gates_phased_blocking_when_assets_exist.code_switch: MANDATORY FOR THE FIRST PRODUCTION PROMOTION (Codex review #6 + owner one-model decision): no artifact becomes THE production model without passing at least one licensed, disjoint code-switch set (kinyarwanda-english/french or pidgin-english/french). This puts the owner-led code-switch licensing on the promotion critical path — deliberate. Synthetic audio is never promotion evidence.
gates_phased_blocking_when_assets_exist.clinical_entities: medical terms, numbers, dosages, negation, emergency phrases — becomes mandatory with the first licensed clinical-entity set

phasing_rationale: declaring unmeasurable gates as blocking today would make promotion impossible forever; declaring them phased-with-trigger keeps them from being quietly dropped
consumers: the universal-model pilot (B5-UNIVERSAL-PILOT-DESIGN-2026-001) and every subsequent production-artifact candidate
machine_enforcement: tests/test_arch_2026_001.py consumes these records; the trainer refuses silent partial language coverage and un-acked multilingual full FT; the one-global-digest registry rule becomes enforceable at the serving-contract step (ARCH sequencing step 6) and is tracked there, not silently dropped
